name: 10xer
description: Extension to connect Claude with the 10xer MCP Server for real-time event streaming.
long_description: The 10xer MCP Server extension enables integration with the 10xer MCP Server, allowing Claude to communicate via server-sent events (SSE) and proxy commands through a local Node.js server.

api_key.title: 10xer MCP API Key
api_key.description: Enter your API key for the 10xer MCP Server. This enables OAuth authentication with Facebook.

account_service_origin.title: Verified 10xer dashboard origin
account_service_origin.description: Enter the HTTPS origin of the 10xer dashboard where your account key was issued. Confirm it with the deployment owner.
